name: megascenes-christmas-card
description: Design Christmas cards with your own message and names in the design, in the style you choose.

interface.longDescription:
Give the message, who the card is from and the look you want: classic red and gold, snowy village, cozy watercolor, modern minimal. You get a Christmas card with your words set in the design, ready to print, post or send.

ChatGPT tells you what the card needs and creates it in your MegaScenes account when you ask. The card opens in the chat and stays in your library.

Give only the words you want printed on the card: no addresses or contact details are needed.

For family cards, office greetings and holiday posts.

Limitations: designs as image files; your text is passed to the model as written, so check the lettering in the result. It does not mail the cards or keep address lists. Making a file needs a signed-in MegaScenes account and runs in it; nothing is made until you confirm. Not for sexual or adult content or for real people's likeness. Files are made by generative models and saved in your MegaScenes library.
capabilities: Set your message and names in the design
Return the card in the chat
defaultPrompt: A classic Christmas card with snowy pines that says Merry Christmas from the Rossi family
A modern minimal Christmas card for my team: Happy Holidays and thank you for this year
A watercolor Christmas card with a cozy cabin and the words Peace and Joy

positive.prompt: A classic Christmas card with snowy pines that says Merry Christmas from the Rossi family. Tell me what it needs, but don't create it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: What one Christmas card needs from the account. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: A modern minimal Christmas card for my team that says Happy Holidays and thank you for this year. Don't create it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: What one card needs. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: Which models can design a Christmas card here?
positive.expected_behavior: The Christmas card models with their settings. Nothing is created.

positive.description: Make it after an explicit request
positive.prompt: A watercolor Christmas card with a cozy cabin in the snow and the words Peace and Joy. Create it now.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT says what the run needs and, once the person confirms, one job starts in the signed-in MegaScenes account; the status tool reports progress and, when it succeeds, returns the file link, which the result view shows.

positive.prompt: Which MegaScenes account am I signed in with?
positive.expected_behavior: The email and plan of the signed-in account. Nothing is created.

negative.prompt: Print my Christmas card on 50 mugs and ship them to my office in Berlin.
Email my Christmas card to my client at sam@example.com.
What is the capital of Portugal?

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments. Making a file runs in the user's existing MegaScenes account; no purchase happens in the conversation.

publication.release_notes: First release: make the file in the connected MegaScenes account and get it back in the conversation.
